Correct GNU libc package. CNA marks versions <2.45 affected; its prose says 2.45 or earlier, but both include 2.42-84. NVD is awaiting analysis without CPE ranges. Trigger requires an attacker-controlled fopen mode with an effectively empty ,ccs= encoding; the upstream observation that this pattern is uncommon does not establish safety for the dogfood scanner runtime. The exact 2.42-master.patch has neither fix 9765a538ebf8661a6e5578e01e35a3dd30db7eb4 nor cca93e5d88d3d4ed073c03100467696f652269e7 or corresponding fopen changes. The proposed 2.44-25 update https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/557451 also lacks these fixes in its master patch; no dedicated Nixpkgs fix was found. Keep active. Sources: https://sourceware.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=34574 and https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-18374.
